analysis.title: GS Quinn - S&P 500 Futures: Semi's Down, Shorts Up
key_insights: Poorly received earnings from Alphabet, Amazon and Intel between Oct 27 and Nov 2 pressured AI exposure. Hyperscalers fell 6.0% and AI Semiconductors fell 11.6%, and the S&P lost 2.4%.
New S&P 500 futures shorts appear to have been initiated. S&P December funding, proxied by the Adjusted Interest Rate future, cheapened 3bps, and S&P E-Mini aggregate open interest rose $13.5bn.

Over the past 6 months, Asset Manager shorts were negatively correlated with AI Semiconductors. In weeks when Semiconductors declined, Asset Manager shorts grew, and the reverse. This suggests Asset Managers may be behind the new shorts.
Asset Manager shorts were near the 2 year median in notional terms as of the last Commitment of Traders update. The note calls this a modest level, so more shorts could be added.
AMD's results bear close monitoring. If they fail to improve sentiment, more downside could surface.

market_movers.rationale: The note says AMD's results bear close monitoring because Asset Manager shorts are at a modest level. If the results fail to improve sentiment, more downside could surface.

sector_views.rationale: AI Semiconductors fell 11.6% from Oct 27 to Nov 2 after disappointing Alphabet, Amazon and Intel earnings. Short positioning in S&P futures appears to be growing alongside the decline.

earnings_insights: Alphabet, Amazon and Intel earnings disappointed between Oct 27 and Nov 2 and were poorly received. The note gives no EPS or revenue figures for any of them.
AMD results are the next catalyst to monitor. The note gives no date and no estimate figures.
risk_factors: AMD results fail to improve sentiment, leading to more downside in semiconductors and S&P futures.
Further Asset Manager short additions, given the modest level of shorts outstanding.
Further disappointing AI-related earnings pressuring Hyperscalers and Semiconductors.
vol_and_positioning: S&P December funding, proxied by the Adjusted Interest Rate future, cheapened 3bps, which the note reads as new shorts being initiated.
S&P E-Mini aggregate open interest jumped $13.5bn.
Asset Manager shorts in S&P futures were near the 2 year median in notional terms as of the last Commitment of Traders update.
Asset Manager shorts were negatively correlated with AI Semiconductors over the past 6 months.
